name: Exp_AdaptiveCGOscillator_X2
summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from two Adaptive Center of Gravity Oscillators with different periods. It enters long when the faster CG oscillator crosses above the slower one and the signal line, and enters short on the opposite crossover. The adaptive component adjusts the oscillator period based on market cycle frequency, making it responsive to changing volatility regimes.
summary_zh: 该EA基于两个不同周期的自适应重心振荡器的交叉信号进行交易。当快速CG振荡器上穿慢速振荡器及信号线时做多，反之做空。自适应组件根据市场周期频率调整振荡器周期，使其对波动率变化具有适应性。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用John Ehlers的自适应重心振荡器(Center of Gravity Oscillator)作为核心策略指标。策略概念基于双周期CG振荡器的交叉系统：快速CG振荡器与慢速CG振荡器的交叉产生交易信号，类似于双均线交叉但基于频域分析而非时域。入场条件为快速CG线上穿慢速CG线时开多仓，快速CG线下穿慢速CG线时开空仓，同时参考信号线的位置进行过滤。出场条件包括反向交叉信号平仓、固定止损止盈，以及移动止损(trailing stop)保护利润。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额百分比的动态手数计算方式。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损点数设置和追踪止损功能来控制单笔风险，但缺乏整体组合风险控制和最大回撤限制。自适应机制通过Ehlers的周期测量算法动态调整CG振荡器的周期参数，使策略在不同市场波动环境下保持敏感性。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs John Ehlers' Adaptive Center of Gravity Oscillator as its core strategic indicator. The strategy concept is based on a dual-period CG oscillator crossover system: the fast CG oscillator crossing the slow CG oscillator generates trade signals, analogous to a dual moving average crossover but operating in the frequency domain rather than the time domain. Entry conditions trigger a long position when the fast CG line crosses above the slow CG line, and a short position on the opposite crossover, with additional filtering based on the signal line position. Exit conditions include closing on reverse crossover signals, fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, and a trailing stop mechanism to protect accumulated profits. Position sizing supports both fixed lot size and dynamic calculation based on account balance percentage. Money management features include configurable stop-loss in points and trailing stop functionality to control per-trade risk, though it lacks portfolio-level risk controls and maximum drawdown limits. The adaptive mechanism uses Ehlers' cycle measurement algorithm to dynamically adjust the CG oscillator period, allowing the strategy to maintain sensitivity across different market volatility regimes.

pros: 自适应周期调整机制使振荡器能适应不同市场波动环境，比固定周期振荡器更具鲁棒性
双周期CG振荡器交叉系统提供相对平滑的交易信号，减少了频繁交易和假信号
内置止损止盈和移动止损功能提供了基本的风险控制框架
基于Ehlers数字信号处理理论的指标具有坚实的数学基础
pros_en: The adaptive period adjustment mechanism allows the oscillator to adapt to different market volatility regimes, making it more robust than fixed-period oscillators
The dual-period CG oscillator crossover system provides relatively smooth trade signals, reducing frequent trading and false signals
Built-in stop-loss, take-profit, and trailing stop functionality provides a basic risk control framework
The indicator based on Ehlers' digital signal processing theory has a solid mathematical foundation
cons: 均值回归类策略在强趋势市场中容易产生连续亏损，CG振荡器在单边行情中会反复发出错误信号
缺乏交易时间过滤和行情过滤机制，可能在低流动性时段或重大新闻期间产生不利交易
没有最大回撤限制或账户权益保护机制，极端行情下可能遭受重大损失
自适应周期计算增加了计算复杂度，在实时交易中可能导致信号延迟
cons_en: Mean reversion strategies are prone to consecutive losses in strong trending markets, as the CG oscillator repeatedly generates false signals during extended directional moves
Lacks trading session filters and news event filters, potentially generating unfavorable trades during low-liquidity periods or major news releases
No maximum drawdown limit or account equity protection mechanism, which could lead to significant losses during extreme market conditions
The adaptive period calculation increases computational complexity, potentially causing signal latency in real-time trading
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器(如ADX或长周期均线)，在强趋势市场中抑制均值回归信号，减少逆势交易
添加交易时段控制和重大新闻事件过滤，避免在不利时段开仓
增加最大回撤限制和连续亏损后的仓位缩减机制，提升整体资金管理安全性
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (such as ADX or long-period moving average) to suppress mean reversion signals during strong trending markets, reducing counter-trend trades
Add trading session controls and major news event filters to avoid opening positions during unfavorable periods
Add maximum drawdown limits and position reduction mechanisms after consecutive losses to enhance overall money management safety

risk_points: 均值回归策略在趋势行情中存在连续亏损风险，缺乏趋势过滤机制
没有最大回撤保护和连续亏损后的自动降仓机制
自适应周期计算的延迟可能在快速行情中导致入场滞后
risk_points_en: Mean reversion strategy carries consecutive loss risk during trending markets, lacking a trend filter mechanism
No maximum drawdown protection or automatic position reduction after consecutive losses
Latency from adaptive period calculation may cause delayed entries during fast market moves
